false_drift_alert.cause: quant-company-backup.service (18:11:55-18:20:47 UTC) stops services, copies state and starts them again while holding .backup.lock. The 18:17 check ran while the worker was still stopped (it started 18:17:46); reading its package failed, which verify counts as one differing file, and the check reported drift.
false_drift_alert.fix: release.py auto reports waiting_for_lock and judges nothing while the host lock is held
